verdict.rationale: Clara documents its own API for retrieving transactions, users, cards and invoices as JSON with an OpenAPI 3.1 schema. A reconciliation guide covers pulling all transactions for a billing period and exporting them to an accounting system, including incremental re-export by last-update date. This covers programmatic extraction of core spend data, but there is no documented full-account export or offboarding path. missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all account data, explicit open file formats (e.g. CSV/JSON archive) for every data type, an account-closure or data-portability process, and independent corroboration.
